title: Hearty Shattering Egyptian Beef Roast
description: A kid-friendly Egyptian dish featuring a tender beef roast in a rich enchilada sauce, perfect for a family dinner. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional Egyptian cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef roast with cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef roast on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the beef roast from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the enchilada sauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the beef roast to the pot and make sure it is mostly submerged in the sauce.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the beef rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
